title: Integral Bloch statement for surfaces of geometric genus zero
exact_target: For every smooth connected projective complex surface S with $p_g(S)=0$, is the integral Albanese homomorphism $CH_{0}(S)^0\to Alb(S)(C)$ an isomorphism? In particular, if also $q(S)=0$, must degree give $CH_{0}(S)\cong Z$?
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
\paragraph{Statement recorded in the supplied source.}
For every smooth connected projective complex surface S with $p_g(S)=0$, is the integral Albanese homomorphism $CH_{0}(S)^0\to Alb(S)(C)$ an isomorphism? In particular, if also $q(S)=0$, must degree give $CH_{0}(S)\cong Z$?

\subsection{Short English statement}
For every smooth connected projective complex surface S with $p_g(S)=0$, is the integral Albanese homomorphism $CH_{0}(S)^0\to Alb(S)(C)$ an isomorphism? In particular, if also $q(S)=0$, must degree give $CH_{0}(S)\cong Z$?
